Hi there! The contact importer matches columns by their header names, not by position, so the order of your columns doesn’t matter as long as the headers are correct.

- Required headers: **email**, **name**, **company**
- Optional headers you can include: **phone**, **title**, and any custom‑field names you’ve already set up in your workspace.
- Any extra columns that the importer doesn’t recognize will simply be ignored – they won’t block the import.

If you want to be 100 % sure you have the exact header spelling, you can download the sample template from the import screen; it contains the correct headers ready to copy.

Let me know if you need any more help!
